summary: Full backend + frontend testing of AutoGarage MVP. All 25 pytest backend tests pass. UI flows (home, inventory filters/search, vehicle detail, booking, contact, admin login/CRUD, appointments, messages) work end-to-end. Language switcher (NL/EN/TR) and theme switcher with localStorage persistence verified.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Currently works only because frontend also sends Bearer token fallback. For production, explicit origin should be configured.
Passing invalid ObjectId (non-24-hex) raises bson.errors.InvalidId -> 500 rather than a clean 400/404. A 24-hex but non-existent id correctly returns 404.
Accepts arbitrary 'status' strings without validation (no enum check).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby - accessibility warning in console
AuthContext calls GET /api/auth/me on every mount for anonymous visitors, producing 401 console noise. Handled gracefully but pollutes console. Consider skipping /me when no ag_token in localStorage.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In AuthContext.js, skip GET /auth/me if localStorage.getItem('ag_token') is null to remove 401 console noise on public pages.
OPTIONAL: Wrap ObjectId(vid) parsing in try/except and return 400 for malformed ids in /api/vehicles/{vid}, /api/appointments/{aid}/status, /api/vehicles/{vid} (PUT/DELETE), etc.
OPTIONAL: Validate appointment status against an enum (in_afwachting, bevestigd, voltooid, geannuleerd).
OPTIONAL: For production, set explicit CORS_ORIGINS instead of '*' when allow_credentials=True.
OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to vehicle-dialog for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py works but has @app.on_event('startup') which is deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider lifespan.
get_current_user uses ObjectId(payload['sub']) with no try/except - a malformed sub could 500. Low risk since we control token creation.
Admin.js is a single 280+ line file mixing dashboard/vehicles/appointments/messages/dialog logic - could be split into sub-components as feature grows.
No rate limiting or brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions lockout after 5 fails) - not implemented.
Password hash is bcrypt ($2b$) - correct format.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_UIMake vehicle added via admin UI test (not cleaned up). Several TEST_ appointments and contact messages created via API + UI tests remain in DB. Main agent may want to clean these before demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest -v). Uses fresh requests.Session per test to avoid cookie carryover from login. Auth uses Bearer token via localStorage ag_token; login also sets httpOnly cookie (secure, samesite=none). Inventory filter-search requires Enter key press to submit. Admin panel accessible at /admin after login at /login. All data-testid attributes are consistent with those in the review request.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found. All requested features work as designed. Minor improvements listed under action_items are non-blocking.
